title: Exhibit A
stamp: Overruled before I finished the sentence.

scenes.direction: holding up a close-up of his ear
scenes.text: I sent my mate the evidence. Hair. Close-up. Good lighting. It’s browny blondish. Case closed.
She says it’s grey. Grey! There are bits of grey around the ear, sure. Bits. Tiny, distinguished bits.
I’ve just realised I used the word “browny” in court. I have no expert witnesses.
